facts.business: NIIT Learning Systems Limited provides managed learning services, training delivery, and consulting expertise to global corporations, with a focus on outsourcing of proprietary training, GenAI, immersive learning, and advisory services.
key_risks: Revenue recognition accuracy dependent on confirmation of training delivery from customers
Significant trade receivables and unbilled revenue balances with judgments involved in assessing recoverability and expected credit losses
Integration risk from recent acquisitions of MST Group and SweetRush
Dependence on key customers and related party receivables
facts.related_party_note: Trade receivables include Rs. 872.52 million from related parties as at March 31, 2026 (Rs. 670.26 million as at March 31, 2025). No trade or other receivable are due from directors or other officers of the Company either severally or jointly with any other person. Nor any trade or other receivable are due from firms or private Companies respectively in which any director is a partner, a director or a member. Transactions with related parties are in compliance with sections 177 and 188 of the Act, where applicable and the details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements, as required by the applicable accounting standards.
